tips.text: Rush straight to the commander and kill it; if no blueprint drops, abort and relaunch.
Finish the mission once the blueprint drops; aborting after it appears throws it away.
Farm the Pennant in the same runs; its blueprint rolls separately on the same kill.
Run with a squad when you can; the blueprint pickup is shared, so one drop pays out for all four.
Skip Korm's Belt; it only sometimes has a Galleon, so check the objectives and relaunch if the boss is missing.
Fly about 8 km away from the ship right after loading in, then Slingshot or Archwing over to the base above the fighters.
Bring Ivara's sleep arrows or an invisibility frame like Loki to reach the boss without clearing the base.
Leave loot abilities at home; Desecrate, Pilfering Swarm, Prowl, Ore Gaze and the like do not work on these bosses.
Wait inside the Galleon until everyone else is in before the killer leaves; the interior can vanish for players still outside.
Players call it fine pure RNG with short runs, usually a few evenings if you farm it on purpose.
